config.single_variable: Initial stop distance as a fraction of the frozen causal entry risk. Outward exchange tick rounding; all entries, directions, event multiplicity, matched controls and deadlines unchanged.
config.exit: Native initial stop or entry+120minute market close, no TP, BE, ATR or H1 exit. Only one barrier so OHLC high/low ordering does not affect exit outcomes.
config.primary_metric: Owner correction: each variant defines1R from its OWN new stop distance. NetR includes unchanged20bp fee divided by that new risk. Independent equal-risk trade sums, not account compounding; tighter stops imply larger exposure per equal risk budget.
config.diagnostics: Report net/gross win rates, netR, PF, stop frequency, median stop width and feeR; paired baseline winner losses and average notional bp. Original-risk accounting is an internal bridge only, not the headline metric.
config.selection: Choose among baseline and three tighter stops by first chronological year's mean new-risk netR; check later-year performance and paired baseline change. Reused history is descriptive, not untouched validation. Matched-random edge and paired improvement tests use weeks; Holm across16edge and12improvement comparisons.
